verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance publishes a public, OAuth-secured OpenAPI v3 API for server-to-server integrations, with rate-limit and idempotency guidance. The product itself monitors entity statuses and sends customizable annual-report reminders, and shows due dates and filing status. However, the only API endpoints the evidence confirms are registered-agent-deliveries reads, so it is unproven that an agent can programmatically read entity standing or filing deadlines. No webhooks are documented, and reminders appear to be user-facing only. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for entity standing and filing due dates, registrable webhooks or event callbacks for status or deadline changes, and hands-on or independent corroboration of agent-driven monitoring.
